title: GET /books/{id} unreachable at runtime — mux never routes /books/{id}
evidence: main.go:268 registers http.HandleFunc("/books", ...); Go's ServeMux treats a no-trailing-slash pattern as an exact path, so it matches only "/books". Empirically verified: a live server (go build + run) returns Go's default "404 page not found" for `curl /books/1`, proving no handler matched. The else-branch at main.go:277-288 that dispatches getBookHandler is dead at runtime; r.URL.Path=="/books" (main.go:269) is always true when the handler fires. TestGetBookById (main_test.go:188) passes only because it calls getBookHandler directly, bypassing the mux.
suggestion: Register "/books/" (trailing slash, subtree match) as a second handler, or use Go 1.22 method+wildcard patterns e.g. mux.HandleFunc("GET /books/{id}", getBookHandler).

title: PUT /books/{id} unreachable at runtime — same mux routing defect
evidence: updateBookHandler (main.go:168) is dispatched only from the else-branch (main.go:281), which requires the request path to differ from "/books". Since "/books" is an exact-match mux pattern (main.go:268), "/books/1" never routes there. Empirically verified: `curl -X PUT /books/1` against a live server returns "404 page not found". TestUpdateBook (main_test.go:221) passes only by calling updateBookHandler directly.
suggestion: Same fix as R4 — register "/books/" or a Go 1.22 "PUT /books/{id}" pattern.

title: DELETE /books/{id} unreachable at runtime — same mux routing defect
evidence: deleteBookHandler (main.go:222) is dispatched only from the else-branch (main.go:283); "/books/1" does not match the exact "/books" pattern registered at main.go:268. Empirically verified: `curl -X DELETE /books/1` against a live server returns "404 page not found". TestDeleteBook (main_test.go:246) passes only by calling deleteBookHandler directly.
suggestion: Same fix as R4 — register "/books/" or a Go 1.22 "DELETE /books/{id}" pattern.

title: Test suite calls handlers directly, so no test exercises the mux — the routing bug passes 12 green tests
evidence: Every by-id test (main_test.go:48,79,193,251,262,346,369,379) invokes getBookHandler/updateBookHandler/deleteBookHandler directly on an httptest recorder rather than routing through http.DefaultServeMux. No test issues an HTTP request against the registered mux, so the R4/R5/R6 runtime 404 is invisible to the suite (defect_rate=1.0, test_coverage=0.597). test-api.sh:37 (curl /books/1) would have exposed it but is not run by `go test`.
suggestion: Add at least one test that serves via the real mux (httptest.NewServer(mux) or mux.ServeHTTP) so route registration is covered.

title: 12 tests with 0 skips, well beyond the 3 required (R12)
evidence: main_test.go defines 12 Test functions including validation and not-found cases (TestCreateBookValidation, TestGetNonExistentBook, TestUpdate/DeleteNonExistentBook); grep for t.Skip found 0 skips. Note token_efficiency=0.004 in scores.json is very low but is not a spec requirement.
suggestion: None — this is beyond spec; surfaced for cross-run comparison.
